text: ……　……　……　……　みとめたく　ねーけど

structure.jp: ……　……　……　……　みとめたく　ねーけど
structure.en: ...not that I want to admit it, though

patterns.name: 〜たい
patterns.explanation: たい on a verb means 'want to'; to say 'don't want to' it changes to たくない, and ねー is a rough slurred ない. みとめたく　ねー = 'I don't want to admit it'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.explanation: けど means 'but' or 'though'; left hanging at the end, the rest is unsaid. みとめたく　ねーけど = 'I don't want to admit it, but...'.
